Markets.title: US stocks today: Nasdaq rebounds as chipmakers rally, Apple slides ahead of US midterm results
Markets.summary: US stocks finished mixed as the Nasdaq rebounded due to gains in chipmakers and artificial intelligence heavyweights ahead of the midterm elections. Apple shares declined amid concerns over increasing memory chip costs and holiday quarter margins.

Markets.title: US Treasury yields climb as strong jobs data, midterm polls weigh; 10-year yield eyes 5% again
Markets.summary: US Treasury yields rose due to stronger-than-expected September jobs data that signaled economic resilience. Investors also remained cautious while awaiting the midterm election results and monitoring US fiscal policy uncertainty.

Markets.title: Taco Bell sales fall more than expected on cyclosporiasis outbreak hit
Markets.summary: Taco Bell's third-quarter sales declined more than expected after a cyclosporiasis outbreak negatively impacted customer traffic. Despite this setback, the company surpassed profit expectations as sales recovered in September and October.

Markets.title: Polymarket unit gets US industry organization's approval to be futures broker
Markets.summary: Polymarket received National Futures Association approval for its PM Derivatives unit to act as a broker. The company still requires Commodity Futures Trading Commission approval to expand operations while facing an ongoing CFTC investigation regarding its marketing practices.

Markets.title: US midterms put Trump-era crypto boom and prediction markets at risk
Markets.summary: A Democratic takeover of Congress in the US midterms could end the crypto-friendly regulatory environment established under President Donald Trump. This potential shift threatens to bring tighter oversight for digital assets and prediction markets, pressuring companies like Coinbase, Strategy, and Bullish.

Markets.title: CleanMax beats Q2 EBITDA estimates, reports strong H1 growth
Markets.summary: CleanMax exceeded Q2 EBITDA analyst estimates for the third consecutive quarter due to portfolio expansion and strong business performance. The company also reported a 58% increase in H1 EBITDA and a six-fold rise in profit after tax.

Geo-Political.title: Spanish transport minister resigns days after deadly train crash
Geo-Political.summary: Spain's transport minister has resigned following a deadly train collision south of Madrid that killed at least 69 people. Dozens of others were injured in the crash.

Geo-Political.title: Seven flights across Europe targeted by suspected bomb threats
Geo-Political.summary: Seven flights across Poland, Spain, Bulgaria, and Italy were subjected to security checks following suspected bomb threats. Authorities confirmed that no explosives were found on the targeted aircraft.

Geo-Political.title: Binance says fake job interviews used as part of $6.3bn crypto hack
Geo-Political.summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance reports that hackers used fake job interviews on legitimate platforms to orchestrate a $6.3 billion cyberattack. An engineer targeted in the scheme was contacted by scammers posing as company representatives.

Geo-Political.title: NTSB says crucial plane parts found three miles from Florida crash site
Geo-Political.summary: The NTSB said because the parts were found far from the accident site, they fell off before the crash.

Geo-Political.title: Europe on alert after supermarket freezers hit by cyber-attacks in 10 countries
